final.role: Biblioteca Python leve (ONNX, sem GPU) para gerar embeddings densos, esparsos, ColBERT e reranking localmente
final.evidence: lightweight, fast, Python library built for embedding generation; supports a few multilingual models and custom models such as multilingual-e5-small; rerankers via TextCrossEncoder.

conferencia.nota: Gera embeddings multilingues localmente via ONNX, sem GPU; candidata para a camada de busca semantica do hub.
